item.text: {"corrections":[{"pointer":"/answer/report","old_text":"plus less irritation, congestion and perceived oil production.","new_text":"plus less irritation and perceived oil production, without causing forehead congestion.","source_keys":["A13"],"source_excerpt":"It has not caused the congestion on my forehead that results in textured skin and bumps","reason":"Not causing congestion does not establish a reduction in pre-existing congestion."},{"pointer":"/answer/report","old_text":"with softer, calmer skin.","new_text":"with soft skin and no redness, irritation or clogged pores.","source_keys":["A14"],"source_excerpt":"I've been adding a drop of this to my moisturizer at night and I wake up with super soft skin with no redness, irritation, or clogged pores.","reason":"The account reports softness and absence of adverse symptoms, without explicitly establishing comparative improvement in softness or pre-existing redness and irritation."}],"unresolved_material_issues":[],"summary":"Corrected two descriptions that strengthened reported outcomes into unsupported improvements."}
